item.title: Morning Boo: Why Halloween Starts in July
item.description:
It's time for business to get spooky...
Happy (almost) Halloween. It wouldn’t be late October without a newsletter discussing the intricacies of everyone’s favorite Home Depot skeleton. Welcome to Morning Boo, our annual edition about the business of Halloween, from how the holiday has crept into the summer months, to the rising profession of porch stylists who make sure your stoop is vibier than your neighbor’s. Whip out the fake cobwebs, stock up on Sour Patch Kids, and light your Witches’ Brew Yankee Candle. We’re gettin’ spooky.
https://www.morningbrew.com/issues/morning-boo-2026

item.description:

But according to Nielsen, 72 million people—that’s about one-fifth of the US population—watched at least one episode in the first eight months of this year . Not that there’s anything wrong with that.
